info.title: Parse Report API
info.description: Parses a One-Click Report row to extract key fields and Salesforce record IDs from error messages.

post.description: Takes a raw One-Click Report row (user, datetime, processidentifier, errormessage, description) and returns structured parsed data with any extracted Salesforce Vlocity Error Log IDs and PS Exception Log IDs found in the error message.

user.description: Agent LAN ID who submitted the report

datetime.description: Timestamp when the report was submitted (ISO 8601 or similar)

processidentifier.description: OmniScript process identifier from the report

errormessage.description: Raw error message text which may contain Salesforce record IDs

description.description: Agent-entered free-text description of the issue

vlocity_log_ids.description: Extracted Vlocity Error Log Salesforce IDs

exception_log_ids.description: Extracted PS Exception Log Salesforce IDs

has_direct_ids.description: True if Salesforce IDs were found in the error message for direct lookup
